preamble.title: Preamble
preamble.content: These General Terms of Use (hereinafter "GTU") define the legal framework for the terms of access to and use of the MarocAdsZone website and the services offered, as well as the rights and obligations of Users.

article1.content: The MarocAdsZone website is published by: Company name: DEVTI GROUP SARL Email: support@devtigroup.com

article2.title: Article 2: Definitions
article2.site: Site: refers to the MarocAdsZone website accessible at www.marocadszone.com.
article2.user: User: any natural or legal person using the Site.
article2.services: Services: all features offered on the Site (posting and viewing listings, internal messaging, account creation, etc.).
article2.advertiser: Advertiser: User publishing a listing on the Site.
article2.content: Content: information published by MarocAdsZone or Users on the Site.

article3.title: Article 3: Access to the Site
article3.content: Access to the Site is free for any User with an Internet connection. All costs necessary to access the Site (hardware, connection, etc.) are the responsibility of the User. Some features may require the creation of an account.

article4.title: Article 4: Registration and User Account
article4.content: To post listings or access certain features, the User must create an account by providing accurate and up-to-date information. The User is responsible for the confidentiality of their login credentials and for all activities carried out on the Site via their account. MarocAdsZone reserves the right to suspend or delete an account in the event of a violation of these GTU.

article5.title: Article 5: Posting Listings
article5.content: Advertisers agree to post listings that comply with applicable Moroccan legislation. MarocAdsZone reserves the right to refuse or remove any listing deemed contrary to public order, public morality, or these GTU.

article6.title: Article 6: Intellectual Property
article6.content: All content on the Site (texts, images, logos, videos) is protected by copyright and remains the property of their authors or MarocAdsZone. Any total or partial reproduction without prior authorization is prohibited.

article7.title: Article 7: Liability
article7.content: The information published on the Site is provided for informational purposes only. MarocAdsZone does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of the information posted online. MarocAdsZone cannot be held liable for direct or indirect damages resulting from the use of the Site or content published by Users.

article8.title: Article 8: User Obligations
article8.intro: By using the Site, the User agrees to:
article8.item0: Not publish any unlawful, defamatory or indecent content;
article8.item1: Not infringe the rights of third parties;
article8.item2: Not distribute advertising content without authorization;
article8.item3: Not use the Site for fraudulent or malicious purposes;

article9.title: Article 9: Hyperlinks
article9.content: The Site may contain links to other websites. MarocAdsZone has no control over these sites and disclaims all responsibility for their content.

article10.title: Article 10: Cookies
article10.content: The Site uses cookies to improve the user experience and analyze traffic. To find out more, please consult our Cookie Policy.

article11.title: Article 11: Personal Data Protection
article11.content: Data collected on the Site is processed in accordance with Moroccan laws on personal data protection. For more information, please consult our Privacy Policy.

article12.title: Article 12: Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
article12.content: These GTU are governed by Moroccan law. In the event of a dispute, the courts of Casablanca shall have jurisdiction.

article13.title: Article 13: Modification of the GTU
article13.content: MarocAdsZone reserves the right to modify these GTU at any time. Users are invited to regularly consult the updated version of the GTU on the Site.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding the application of these GTU, you can contact MarocAdsZone by email at: contact@marocadszone.com

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Protecting your personal data is a priority for MarocAdsZone. This Privacy Policy is intended to inform you about how we collect, use and protect your data when you use our classifieds platform. By using our site, you agree to the practices described in this policy. We invite you to read it carefully.

article2.title: 2. Types of data collected
article2.content: When using MarocAdsZone, we may collect the following data:
advertisers_list: Identification data (name, first name, phone number, email address)

article3.title: 3. Purposes of processing
article3.content: We collect your personal data for the following purposes:
list: Creation and management of your user account
Publication and management of ads
Connecting advertisers and visitors
Improving our services and performance analysis
Sending communications related to your account or ads
Compliance with legal obligations and fraud prevention

article4.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
article4.content: The processing of your data is based on:
list: Execution of the contract when using our services
Your consent, particularly for sending promotional offers
Our legitimate interests in improving our services
Compliance with our legal obligations

article5.title: 5. Data retention period
article5.account: Account data: for the duration of your registration and up to 3 years after last activity
article5.ads: Ad data: during publication and up to 3 years after deletion
article5.billing: Billing data: according to legal retention periods
article5.after: After these periods, your data is deleted or anonymized

article6.title: 6. Data recipients
article6.content: Your data may be shared with:
list: Authorized MarocAdsZone staff
Our technical subcontractors (hosting, maintenance)
Site visitors for ad-related data
Administrative and judicial authorities if required by law

article7.title: 7. Data transfers outside Morocco
article7.content: Some data may be transferred outside Morocco (for example via our hosting providers). We ensure that these transfers are secure and comply with applicable regulations.

article8.title: 8. Your rights
article8.content: In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the following rights:
list: Right of access: obtain a copy of your data
Right of rectification: correct inaccurate data
Right to erasure: request deletion of your data
Right to object: object to certain processing
Right to restriction: restrict the processing of your data
Right to portability: receive your data in a readable format
Right to withdraw your consent at any time
article8.contact: To exercise your rights, contact us by email at: contact@marocadszone.com

article9.title: 9. Data security
article9.content: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:
list: Encryption of sensitive data
Data access control
Regular backups
Staff awareness of confidentiality

article10.title: 10. Cookies
article10.content: For more information on the use of cookies, see our Cookie Policy.

article11.title: 11. Policy changes
article11.content: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Changes will be published on this page and will take effect immediately.

contact.title: 12. Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding this policy or your personal data, you can contact us at: Email: support@devtigroup.com
